roles.cdrl_migrator: owner of public schema and business tables; DDL owner
roles.cdrl_writer: INSERT and UPDATE on games and game_metrics only
roles.cdrl_operator: maintenance monitoring through pg_monitor; no business table access

securityControls: REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC
passwords are supplied through Docker environment variables
SQL contains no passwords or tokens
writer has no DELETE, TRUNCATE or table ownership
operator has no business table grants
validationCases: writer can insert and update a metric
operator SELECT on business tables is rejected
limitations: Docker init scripts run only when the PostgreSQL data volume is initialized
The exact commit SHA is completed when week-03-final is tagged
